name: a_deals_filings
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Deals, offerings, filings.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
M&A (terms, value, withdrawn or approved deals), equity/convert/debt offerings (size, price, coupon), activist stakes, 13D/13G, buybacks, index adds/deletes, IPOs, lockup expiries, large contracts with $ value.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **PTC** [Software & SaaS]
- Schneider Electric agreed to acquire PTC for **$205 per share in cash**, valuing PTC’s equity at approximately **$22.6 billion**; closing is expected in **Q3 2027**. (Reuters, Oct 5 05:45 ET)

## **SWKS / QRVO** [Wireless & Mobile]
- Skyworks Solutions and Qorvo were scheduled to complete their previously announced **cash-and-stock merger on Oct. 5**, creating a company valued at approximately **$22 billion**; Skyworks extended the expiration and withdrawal deadlines for exchanges of Qorvo’s **2029 and 2031 senior notes**, offering up to **$850 million** of new 2029 notes and **$700 million** of new 2031 notes. [report] (Stocktwits/Yahoo Finance, Oct 5 07:31 ET)

## **ON / SYNA** [Semiconductors]
- ON Semiconductor revised the terms of its proposed acquisition of Synaptics; the revised transaction value was reported at **$5.7 billion**, and Synaptics shares were reported up **14.1%**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 5 08:22 ET)

## **AMD** [AI Compute]
- AMD announced an agreement to acquire AI model and research company World Labs in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately **$8.2 billion**; closing was expected by **year-end 2026**. (Stocktwits/Yahoo Finance, Oct 5 07:31 ET)

## **PSKY / WBD** [Internet & Platforms]
- Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery’s previously announced transaction, valued at approximately **$110.9 billion**, was scheduled to close on **Oct. 6** after the companies agreed to settlement negotiations with states that had sought to block the deal. (Stocktwits/Yahoo Finance, Oct 5 07:31 ET)

## **SSTI** [Software & SaaS]
- Transom Signal AcquireCo agreed to acquire SoundThinking through a tender offer at **$8.00 per share in cash**, plus one contingent value right per share providing up to **$3.00** in additional cash tied to specified revenue milestones; a shareholder group led by Lauder reported beneficial ownership of **2,255,406 shares, or 17.0%**, as of Oct. 2. (SEC EDGAR, Oct 2 17:34 ET)

## **SPKL / ZincFive** [Power & Wide-Bandgap]
- Spark I Acquisition and ZincFive filed an investor presentation for their proposed business combination; the transaction implied approximately **$762 million of enterprise value**. The related Form S-4 registration statement was filed on **Sept. 30** and had **not yet been declared effective** as of the Oct. 2 filing. (SEC filing, Oct 2 17:44 ET)

## **ASPI / ENDRA** [Pharma]
- ENDRA Life Sciences filed a Form S-4 registration statement for its proposed merger involving ASP Isotopes’ Noble Africa subsidiary and Renergen; the transaction remained subject to satisfaction or waiver of the merger agreement’s conditions. (SEC filing, Oct 2 06:01 ET)

## **SAIQ** [Space & Communications]
- Columbus Acquisition completed its business combination with WISeSat.Space Holdings on **Oct. 1**; the combined company’s ordinary shares began trading on Nasdaq under ticker **SAIQ** on **Oct. 2**. (SEC filing, Oct 2 07:37 ET)

## **MAT** [Retail]
- Authentic Brands Group approached Mattel regarding a potential takeover that could value Mattel at approximately **$6 billion or more**, with discussions involving an offer above **$20 per share**. [rumor][report] (Reuters, reported Oct 4; publication time unavailable)

## **FUL** [Specialty Materials & IP Licensing]
- Ancora Holdings increased its proposed cash offer for H.B. Fuller’s building-adhesives unit to as much as **$1.4 billion** after the company’s board rejected its prior offer. (Reuters, reported Oct 4; publication time unavailable)

## **FISV** [Software & SaaS]
- Jana Partners urged Fiserv to more than double its planned cost reductions and use Palantir software in its technology-transformation program. (Reuters, reported Oct 4; publication time unavailable)

## **MGM / PPLI** [Retail]
- HighSage Ventures said it supported a potential MGM Resorts acquisition of People Inc.; the position was disclosed in a **13D filing**. (SEC 13D filing, reported Oct 4; publication time unavailable)

## **IRT / CSR** [Real Estate]
- Irenic Capital Management opposed Independence Realty Trust’s proposed acquisition of Centerspace and asked Independence Realty Trust to consider alternatives, including a sale. (Irenic Capital press release, reported Oct 4; publication time unavailable)
